device.modelDescription: a handler that says when it has started, in its data directory, then holds its worker until the test releases it: a test can order a reload, and every step after it, by events, not sleeps

actionList.name: busy
actionList.description: Writes /data/started, then holds its worker until /data/release exists (at most input.maxMs, default 20 s), and answers {ok: true}.
